sample_frame_pairs: sample frame pairs from a FrameRange using multiple SamplePairsOptions strategies
sample_hierarchical_pairs: generate hierarchical frame pairs with configurable min and max distance between frames
sample_consecutive_pairs: generate consecutive frame pairs by sampling adjacent frames in a sequence
sample_exhausted_pairs: generate all possible frame pairs exhaustively for a given number of frames
convert_to_one_way_pairs: convert two-way frame pairs to one-way pairs by ordering each pair ascending
